enrichment.headline: Approves an amendment to the special education early intervening services grant plan, running through Sept. 2026
enrichment.summary: This amends the district's compliance and monitoring plan for Comprehensive Coordinated Early Intervening Services (CCEIS), a federal special education grant under the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act, Part B. It also authorizes sending the amendment to the California Department of Education. The period runs July 1, 2024 through September 30, 2026. The text does not state a dollar amount or say what changed.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment, 2023 Comprehensive Coordinated Early Intervening Services (CCEIS) Plan and Budget - Special Education Services - Chief Academic Officer

enrichment.headline: Approves up to $1,137,000 for Elite Security Services to add unarmed campus security staff
enrichment.summary: Elite Security Services of Oakland will provide an extra layer of unarmed, non-law enforcement security staff. They will monitor campus perimeters, entryways and safe passages, assess potential threats and help calm safety situations. Assignments begin at six school sites, plus Board and committee meetings and other district events, and the agreement runs September 16, 2024 through June 30, 2025. Its start date is before this board vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement - Elite Security Services - Office of the Chief of Staff

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $31,200 for a contractor to run ParentSquare family messaging across the district
enrichment.summary: An individual contractor from Pacifica will support day-to-day use of ParentSquare, the district's home-school communication tool. The contractor will create and update user accounts, give technical help to staff and parents, and collect data on how much it is used. The agreement runs July 1, 2024 through June 30, 2025, and started before the board's approval.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2024-2025 - Chimedregzen Altankhuyag - Office of the Chief of Staff

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $108,376.40 for Oakland Natives Give Back's Attend Learn and Succeed Together program
enrichment.summary: Oakland Natives Give Back of Oakland will provide its Attend Learn and Succeed Together (ALAST) program through the Office of the Chief of Staff, as described in an exhibit to the agreement that is not included in the text. The agreement runs September 1, 2024 through May 31, 2025, and started before the board's approval.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2024-2024 - Oakland Natives Give Back - Office of the Chief of Staff

enrichment.summary: The board is adopting administrative regulations for Measure G1, the Districtwide Teacher Retention and Middle School Improvement Act. The adoption follows a recommendation from the Measure G1 Oversight Commission. The text does not describe the regulations' contents or any dollar amount.

enrichment.summary: The board is adopting Resolution No. 2324-0180, based on a recommendation from the Measure G1 Oversight Commission. It approves carryover allocations of unspent 2023-2024 Measure G1 funds (the Districtwide Teacher Retention and Middle School Improvement Act) for named district and charter schools. The text does not name the schools or state dollar amounts.

enrichment.headline: Ratifies the minutes of the Board of Education's September 11, 2024 regular meeting
enrichment.summary: The board is approving the written minutes of its regular meeting on September 11, 2024. Staff prepared the minutes shortly after that meeting. There is no money involved.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Minutes - Board of Education - Regular Meeting – September 11, 2024

enrichment.headline: Adds $35,100 to Jensen Hughes' contract for Fremont High fire and intrusion alarm engineering
enrichment.summary: This amendment adds $35,100 to an existing engineering contract with Jensen Hughes, Inc. for Phase II design and consulting work on the fire alarm and intrusion alarm systems in the Fremont High School modernization. The contract's not-to-exceed amount rises from $119,470 to $154,570. All other terms stay the same.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Amendment No. 2a, Agreement for Engineering Services – Jensen Hughes, Inc., - Fremont High School Modernization Fire Alarm, Intrusion Alarm, & Fire Sprinkler Systems Engineering Services Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Pays Professional Services Industries up to $3,927 for an environmental site report at Coliseum College Prep
enrichment.summary: The district hires Professional Services Industries, Inc. to prepare an environmental site assessment report for the Coliseum College Preparatory Academy site expansion project. The cost is capped at $3,927, which includes a $357 contingency for additional services. Work is scheduled from October 10, 2024 to September 26, 2025.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: General Services Agreement – Professional Services Industries, Inc. – Coliseum College Preparatory Academy Site Expansion Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Pays Terraphase Engineering $48,032 for environmental review consulting at Coliseum College Prep
enrichment.summary: The district hires Terraphase Engineering, Inc. for California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) consulting, including a preliminary findings memorandum, for the Coliseum College Preparatory Academy modernization project. The $48,032 price includes a $4,313 contingency fee. The text says work starts October 10, 2024 and lasts until September 26, 2024, which is before the start date.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
